Add Pipeup to a page

Designed

Add Pipeup to a page

One script tag, pinned to a version, and a document key that stays the same once people have commented.

The html tag
<html data-pipeup-doc="MQQLnEw1V1KQtXotdXeyksEYEB60YVpvSh65pKhcG38">
Just before the end of body
<script
  src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pipeup@0.8.2/dist/pipeup.min.js"
  integrity="sha384-…"
  crossorigin="anonymous"
></script>

Make a key in any browser console on a page with Pipeup loaded: await Pipeup.newDocumentAttribute()

One file, no dependencies: put pipeup.min.js next to the page and it works from disk.

Run the check

What Pipeup changes or covers on the page, at three widths.

Terminal
$ npx --yes pipeup@0 check page.html
pipeup check
page.html
  390: nothing covered, nothing changed
  820: nothing covered, nothing changed
 1280: nothing covered, nothing changed
✓ page.html is ready to review

Give Tom the one line that turns his page into a reviewable one, and the key that keeps every copy of the file one document.

Persona at this step
TATom Adeyemi

Tom has finished the report as an HTML file. He wants review on it with as little as possible.

Content
  • The headline "Add Pipeup to a page" and one line: "One script tag, pinned to a version, and a document key that stays the same once people have commented."
  • Two code blocks with Copy: the document key for the html tag, data-pipeup-doc="…", and the script tag just before </body> with its integrity.
  • Beneath, the way to make a key: "Make a key in any browser console on a page with Pipeup loaded: await Pipeup.newDocumentAttribute()". And one muted line: "One file, no dependencies: put pipeup.min.js next to the page and it works from disk."
  • After Copy (success): the button reads "Copied" in place, and the way on: "Next: run the check".
Components
Button linkCode block compact
States
  • EmptyNot applicable
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorWhen the clipboard is blocked, the block's text is selected and the label reads "Press Ctrl+C".
Interactions
  • Copy copies the block whole, reads "Copied" for a moment and keeps its width; when the clipboard is blocked the text is selected and the label says how to finish.
  • "Next: run the check" opens check-the-page.
Requirements
  • FR-024 An author adds Pipeup with one pinned script tag and one document key, both copied whole from one page, and the key is made once and kept.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-add-the-script-1FR-024PassedGiven the page, when Tom presses Copy on the script block, then the clipboard holds exactly the script tag with its pinned version and integrity, and the button reads "Copied".
  2. AC-add-the-script-2FR-024PassedGiven the page, when it is read, then it offers exactly two things to copy, the key attribute and the script tag, and one way to make a key.

This screen

Run the check

Open in prototypesetup.html#check-the-page

Show Tom what the check says about his page: what Pipeup changes or covers at three widths, so he fixes it before anyone reviews.

Persona at this step
TATom Adeyemi

He added the line. Before sending the file he wants to know nothing on the page is covered by the tag or shifted.

Content
  • The command in a terminal block: npx --yes pipeup@0 check page.html.
  • Its report below, as the terminal prints it (default): three widths, 390, 820 and 1280, each "nothing covered, nothing changed", then "✓ page.html is ready to review".
  • When something is wrong (error): one width lists what the tag covers, "1280: the tag covers the page's own footer link 'Contact'", with the fix: "mark it with data-pipeup-ignore, or give the page a reserved gutter".
Wording
  • {width}: nothing covered, nothing changed a width that passes.
  • {width}: the tag covers the page's own {what} a width that fails, with the fix beneath it.
Components
Code block compact, strong
States
  • EmptyNot applicable
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorThe error state: a width that fails, with the fix.
Interactions
  • Copy copies the command without the prompt. The report is text; nothing on it acts.
  • The fix line names what to do; after the change, running the check again shows the pass.
Requirements
  • FR-027 The check reports, at three widths, what Pipeup would change or cover on a page, names the fix, and says when the page is ready to review.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-check-the-page-1FR-027PassedGiven the command, when Tom presses Copy, then the clipboard holds exactly the command with no prompt.
  2. AC-check-the-page-2FR-027PassedGiven a page that passes, when the report renders, then it lists 390, 820 and 1280 each with "nothing covered, nothing changed" and ends "ready to review".
  3. AC-check-the-page-3FR-027PassedGiven a page whose footer link the tag covers at 1280, when the report renders, then it names the link and the fix.

This journey

Add Pipeup to a page

Tom adds one script tag and a document key to his page, runs the check that says what Pipeup changes or covers, and sends the page.

Goal
Tom turns his HTML page into a reviewable one with one line, and knows before sending it that nothing on it is covered or changed.
Trigger
He has finished the report and wants feedback by Friday.
Outcome
His page carries Pipeup with a pinned version and a document key, the check passes, and the page is on its way.
Success
One line and one key are all a page needs (FR-024). The check names anything Pipeup would cover or change before anyone sees it.
